purpose: Frozen v3 diagnosis and ordinary-alternative audit, not independent final testing

simple_controls.selection: Original inner validation only; equal-domain cell MAE; ties prefer smaller weight
simple_controls.warning: Stored PLS is the existing P04 source-trained projection plus GPR, not PLSR

diagnosis.quality: Processed V/I/time proxies only; no inference about raw dropout from interpolated 128-point arrays
diagnosis.aggregation: Points within cell, cells within domain, domains equally within dataset; report bin coverage

M3: Not enabled. Diagnose gap first; separate prospective protocol required before any M3 scores.
external: No held-out labels opened by this evaluation. Audit historical usage before separate frozen final confirmation.
limits: Development labels permitted for retrospective diagnosis only
No retraining or mutation of v3
Simple-control performance is not a bibliographic novelty proof
